guarantees.rule: Every supported Factorio target is delivered as one self-contained MIR player ZIP.
Official integrations required for the target are built into that ZIP and remain inert when their external mod is absent.
No separately downloaded MIR core, feature module, compatibility pack, runtime, or shared library is required for normal play.
Optional extensions may add capabilities but may not be required to recover behavior advertised as part of MIR itself.
Each target package is generated, versioned, qualified, sealed, published, and read back independently from the same source release.
Developer kits, schemas, fixtures, tests, governance, assurance evidence, repository tools, and release records remain outside player ZIPs.
